title: Riso
description: A Beatles cover and a short line pulled as a three-colour risograph: yellow, fluorescent pink and medium blue land one drum at a time with grainy halftone ink on toothy paper. Drag the print to fix each drum's misregistration, pick a cover or a line and pull another.
intent: One print process done faithfully: the cover is separated into three real riso inks in log density space, screened at classic angles with grain, ink starvation and paper tooth, and each drum is a layer you can knock out of and back into register.
sources: herb reference board: 039a956a magazine cut-out (halftoned print, newsprint serif) and the hand-made collage marks
